description: This file defines the 'AttachmentsTab' React component and related subcomponents used in a trace viewer UI to display and manage attachments including images, diffs, and textual files. It handles rendering of attachments, loading textual content, and displaying image comparisons within a trace analysis frontend.

classes.name: ExpandableAttachment
classes.description: A React component that displays an expandable view for an attachment, including loading textual content or showing download link if applicable.

methods.name: attachmentURL
methods.description: Generates a URL for accessing the attachment based on the trace model and attachment data.

methods.name: downloadURL
methods.description: Creates a download URL with appropriate parameters for a given attachment.

methods.name: attachmentKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for an attachment element in React list rendering.
